author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Copies the public chat you choose to one of your Discord webhooks, in small batches with privacy filters.
changelog: 4.1.8: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.8, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 1.0.0: initial disabled-by-default release with Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok support; exact bot and viewer ignore rules; command and simulation gates; bounded in-memory batching; Discord mention neutralization; creator-approved one-use relay delivery; and no local chat transcript or webhook storage.

manifest.name: Discord Chat Archive
installationSteps: Create a private Discord webhook for the archive channel and add it under Platforms > Discord webhooks.
Choose that webhook in Discord Chat Archive settings, review the privacy notice and ignore list, then enable it.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. No chat transcript is stored by StreamBridge.

healthChecks.description: Checks that public chat filtering, batching, and Discord posting work.
